narration.bridge: Each agent archives clean visual keys and values with its camera pose. At a matching view, the other agent retrieves them into attention.
narration.demo: B scouts a view. A later looks there and retrieves B's visual keys and values. Three scenes show the same exchange, with the radar marking the return.
narration.close: Shared visual memory across agents. Code and evidence on GitHub.

scope: GPU-verified peer visual KV injection in both directions; static serial visits
